title: Cyberpunk Arcade Guardian
description: A fierce female warrior with red hair and a red outfit stands in a combat pose on a concrete ledge in the foreground. Behind her, three women in colorful retro dresses walk toward an Apollo Arcade sign as a giant glowing robot with a Mayan-inspired circular headdress looms over a vibrant cyberpunk city at sunset.
prompt: A dynamic cyberpunk scene at sunset featuring a confident female warrior with flowing dark red hair, red outfit and cape, combat boots, and chained gloves standing in a fighting stance in the foreground. Behind her, three women in colorful 70s-style patterned dresses walk toward an Apollo Arcade neon sign. A massive towering robot with glowing orange eyes and a large circular Aztec-Mayan patterned headdress dominates the background above a dense futuristic city skyline with glowing buildings under a dramatic cloudy sky.
